privacy.privacy_unit: one participating client's complete local dataset slot
privacy.adjacency_definition: Replace one fixed-roster client's contribution by zero while keeping the roster and every public weight unchanged; all other client slots are identical.
privacy.key_ownership: trusted decryptor owns the CKKS secret key; clients and server receive public encryption context
privacy.threat_model: server cannot decrypt individual ciphertexts; the trusted decryptor is honest, does not collude with the server, sees the clean aggregate, and is excluded from the DP guarantee
privacy.release_set: validation-selected global checkpoints and their post-processing validation metrics; no clean aggregates, individual updates, client counts, noise seeds, or unclipped diagnostics
privacy.noise_placement: one Gaussian vector after trusted decryption of the homomorphic weighted sum
privacy.noise_rng_assumption: ideal independent Gaussian samples; reproducible PRNG seed is stored in the private artifact directory and not suitable as a production CSPRNG claim

homomorphic_encryption.key_model: public-key encryption and trusted decryptor; process isolation is not enforced in this simulation

scope_note: Versioned follow-up; v1 configurations, outputs, and round-0 result are preserved.
